name: Commander
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: High Perception; high Warfare Lore, moderate Society; high Int, moderate Str; high AC; low Fortitude, moderate Reflex, high Will; moderate HP; moderate accuracy and moderate damage. Abilities: Commander's banner (aura giving allies within 30 feet a +1 status bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear), three tactics appropriate for their level (one used per round, allies in the encounter count as squadmates), Drilled Reactions, Shield Block

notes.defense: High AC; low Fortitude, moderate Reflex, high Will; moderate HP.
notes.offense: Moderate attack bonus and moderate damage.
notes.specials: Commander's banner (aura giving allies within 30 feet a +1 status bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear), three tactics appropriate for its level (one used per round; allies in the encounter count as squadmates), Drilled Reactions, Shield Block.
